entries.title: II Timothy 4:1
segments: Therefore I solemnly witness before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who is going to judge [the] living and [the] dead according to His appearance and His kingdom,

entries.title: II Timothy 4:2
segments: preach the Word, be instant in season and out of season, reprove, rebuke, exhort with all long-suffering and doctrine.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:3
segments: For the time will be when they will not endure sound doctrine, but they will heap up teachers to themselves according to their own lusts, tickling the ear.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:4
segments: And they will turn away [their] ears from the truth and will be turned to myths.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:5
segments: But you watch in all things, endure afflictions, do [the] work of an evangelist, fully carry out your ministry."

entries.title: II Timothy 4:6
segments: For I am already being poured out, and the time of my release is here.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:7
segments: I have fought a good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:8
segments: Now there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, shall give me at that Day; and not to me only, but also to all those who love His appearing.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:9
segments: Make haste to come to me quickly.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:10
segments: For Demas has forsaken me, having loved this present world, and [he] has departed to Thessalonica. Crescens [went] to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:11
segments: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark [and] bring [him] with you, for he is profitable to me for [the] ministry.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:12
segments: And I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:13
segments: When you come, bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus, and the books, especially the parchments.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:14
segments: Alexander the coppersmith showed many evil things to me. The Lord will give to him according to his works.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:15
segments: You also should beware of [him], for he has greatly withstood our words.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:16
segments: At my first answer no one was beside me, but all deserted me. May it not be laid to their charge.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:17
segments: But the Lord stood with me and strengthened me, that through me the preaching might be fully known, and [that] all the nations might hear. And I was delivered out of [the] mouth of the lion.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:18
segments: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work and will preserve [me] for His heavenly kingdom, to whom [be] glory forever and ever. Amen.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:19
segments: Greet Priscilla and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:20
segments: Erastus stayed at Corinth, but Trophimus I left sick at Miletus.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:21
segments: Try to come before winter. Eubulus greets you, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brothers.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:22
segments: May the Lord Jesus Christ [be] with your spirit. Grace [be] with you. Amen.
